2025-08-11.riddle: I spin and spin, yet stay in place, I cool you down without a face. I hum a song in summer’s heat, my moving blades a breezy treat. What am I?

2025-08-12.riddle: You pick me up and press me to your ear; I keep a secret hum of waves you’ll hear. I treasure tiny memories in spirals and grooves— found on sandy shores where the ocean moves. What am I?
2025-08-12.hint: Hold me to your ear and hear the sea.

2025-08-13.riddle: I pour the present into the past, each grain falling counts a little less. Turn me once and watch the slow parade; I measure patience in golden threads. What am I?
2025-08-13.hint: I show time with sand; flip me to restart.

2025-08-14.riddle: I bite the tide and hold a ship, heavy and cold where sailors grip. I keep the ocean traveler tied and true—without my weight the vessel drifts askew. What am I?
2025-08-14.hint: I keep ships from drifting away.

2025-08-15.riddle: I fold and fly with just a toss, a paper bird that shows no loss. I sail the room with loops and dives—made from notes and passing drives. What am I?
2025-08-15.hint: I’m a folded plane that soars from your hands.

2025-08-16.riddle: I stand in fields with button eyes and straw, I wear old clothes to keep the birds in awe. I watch the rows from dawn till night—my empty grin keeps cornfields right. What am I?
2025-08-16.hint: I scare birds away from crops.

2025-08-17.riddle: I make the tiny huge and the faint so clear; I bend the world close when what you seek is near. With round glass eye I hunt for clues—I show small things that you might lose. What am I?
2025-08-17.hint: I enlarge tiny details so you can see them.

2025-08-18.riddle: I carry all your daily things and hang on straps so wide; with zips and pockets I keep all tucked inside. You wear me on your shoulders as you go— what am I?
2025-08-18.hint: I hold books and gear while you travel.
